descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S07 Empty other context, both directions: 0 patients in one context, 1 in the other

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U6 No data or template leakage between Hospital and Nursing Home. This covers lists, charts, the template picker, custom templates, account-wide screens (search, dashboard counts, Task Export, Inbox, mu … (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Variant a: one Hospital patient and no Nursing Home resident. Variant b: one Nursing Home resident and no Hospital patient. Both seeded; nothing is deleted.

When a: switch to Nursing Home, to Hospital, and to Nursing Home again. b: switch to Nursing Home, to Hospital, to Nursing Home, and to Hospital again.

Then The empty context shows its empty state (not a blank page) and never the other context's patient

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): oracle.mjs: the empty list mustNotContain the other context's patient, and mustContain a list landmark so a blank page fails. The NH add control is not checked by name: the Nursing Home + button has no accessible name (navigation.spec.ts comment). The empty-state wording is TFA-94745's (EFS matrix).

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (blocked)

S07 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.
